title: A Ghost's Guide to Composting Pumpkins 👻🎃
description: More than 1.3 BILLION pounds of pumpkins are thrown in the trash every year in the U.S. How scary! This Halloween, keep things less spooky for the planet by putting your pumpkins in the green bin to be composted. But beware. Stickers, paint or candle wax can haunt your organic waste. Clean pumpkins only, please!
